summary:
P4 wave 1 (Core, producer-first) complete — AlembicCore commit 47391c6 on main (no push/tag/version bump). ADDITIVE TESTS ONLY: no gate file touched (gateRules.ts / UnifiedValidator.ts / recipe-content-quality-gate.ts / recipe-evidence-gate.ts unchanged; gates byte-identical from P1 — git status shows ONLY test/RecipeAuthoringSpecDrift.test.ts modified). No guidance fix was needed: every parity assertion passed against the current renderGuidance, which already lists the verbs + scope-escape + marker rule.

Extended test/RecipeAuthoringSpecDrift.test.ts (was A.6 #4/#6 snapshots only) into the full guidance==gate drift + parity suite, every assertion reading the one gateRules() table:
- #1 allowlist parity: renderGuidance('host-cold-start').imperativeVerbs.positive === getImperativeVerbAllowlist().positive AND the rendered text contains the EXACT verb join + the derived count '共 45 个' (never the vague 'verb-led'); oracle 45 positive / 12 negative.
- #2 marker parity: the content-contrast gate rule guidanceText states both ✅/❌ markers + the '≥4' rule, the rendered text surfaces that exact string, AND the guidance's own worked example (block.example.candidate) passes validateAgainst({stage:1}) with zero violations.
- #3 evidence-floor parity: getEvidenceFloorPolicy() {ruleFiles:3, factFiles:1, scopeEscape} equals the rendered '≥3'/'≥1' floor + the scope-escape source the gate honors (file-local/narrow tested live).
- #7 enforcement-matrix parity: every module gateRules() reject code per stage is present in the checked-in recipe-gate-enforcement-matrix.json — stage-1 is an EXACT set match (8), stage-2 (12⊆19) and stage-3 (7⊆11) are subsets (the matrix also holds the dead SOURCE_REF_BARE + dimension-complete codes + UnifiedValidator field-presence codes); counts frozen 8/19/11 so the layered-not-duplicated matrix can never silently reopen.
- D-A confidence: gateRules() exposes NO confidence-floor reject code AND the rendered guidance text contains no 'confidence' claim — confidence stays recommended, never a fake hard floor.
- §12.5 path-parity tripwire: for a fixture corpus under a FIXED profile (tested cold-start AND opportunistic) and FIXED ports (a deterministic sourceRefResolver + a SESSION_NOT_FOUND sessionScope), validateAgainst(path:'host-cold-start') produces byte-identical violation arrays to validateAgainst(path:'in-process') (toEqual), and the corpus is non-vacuous (host.length>0) — proving the path LABEL does not change the verdict and both real submission paths face the same bar at the Core API.

The standing siblings are referenced, not duplicated: #5 example self-consistency lives in RecipeAuthoringSpecExamplesGatePassing.test.ts (P3); the live gate-file round-trip (matrix codes grepped from the three gate sources) lives in RecipeGateEnforcementMatrix.test.ts (P0.0, P1.3-updated).
